built.note: Graph-first ingestion/activation/reporting with a real dbt Core layer ('From Ran to Right'), for a 90-minute technical deep-dive/competitive eval vs. Cloud Composer. 12 assets (4 ingestion badged fivetran, 6 dbt badged dbt+bigquery -- 3 staging, dim_partner, 2 daily-partitioned facts, 1 activation badged braze, 1 reporting badged powerbi) -- the brief's own '~16 assets' sizing note doesn't match its explicit 12-item enumeration; built the named list, flagged the discrepancy (same precedent as demos/trafigura). dbt runs for real against DuckDB with 11 native not_null/unique tests auto-surfaced as Dagster checks, plus 2 custom checks (1 blocking) computed against real fixture data, not hardcoded passes. Corrected a brief inconsistency: the panel-completeness check was specified to block fct_quotes_daily, which has no real dependency on panel data -- rewired to gate stg_panel_feed's automation and gave fct_bound_policies_daily a genuine ref('stg_panel_feed') dependency so the gating is a real lineage edge. Freshness on both daily facts, eager automation (one check-gated), one 07:00 Europe/London schedule (assumed hour, no SLA given). Raw fixture data (CSVs, deterministic) loaded by a non-Dagster bootstrap at defs-load time, not a Dagster asset -- keeps the ingestion layer genuinely graph-first while giving dbt real rows to test. Reused detroit-dwsd's GraphFirstAssetsComponent verbatim (component-feedback/2026-08-28-graph-first-assets.md); registry searched for power bi/braze/fivetran, confirmed no zero-credential-capable component exists for any of the three. Full validation gate green; verified zero-setup from a fresh clone with no env vars set.

Reused detroit-dwsd's GraphFirstAssetsComponent verbatim rather than re-deriving the same registry gap (component-feedback/2026-08-28-graph-first-assets.md).
